question: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital?
evidence: The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; 'SJS' refers to diagnosis; (SUBTRACT(year(`First Date`)), year(Birthday)); age of the patients when they initially arrived at the hospital refers to year(Birthday)
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0, c1, c2 FROM (SELECT T1.Date AS c0, STRFTIME('%Y', T2."First Date") - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS c1, T2.Birthday AS c2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC) AS __r FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND NOT T2.Birthday IS NULL) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday),T2.Birthday FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.Birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

b.request: For the patient(s) with Diagnosis 'SJS' who have the earliest Birthday (the oldest), including all patients tied for that earliest Birthday, return the date(s) of their laboratory work (Laboratory.Date) and their age at first hospital arrival computed as year(First Date) minus year(Birthday)
b.sql: SELECT L.Date, CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_first_arrival FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND P.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS')

d.request: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital? If several patients tie as the oldest (i.e., share the same earliest Birthday), return all of them.
d.sql: SELECT L.Date, CAST(strftime('%Y', P."First Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%' AND P.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%')
